key_insight: S$^3$R speeds up long-context RL rollouts by using sparse attention only for drafting, then restoring the dense-policy distribution through full-attention speculative verification.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to cut KV-cache traffic in verifiable-reward RL training without changing the response groups that policy optimization depends on.
method: Use self-sparse drafting to propose tokens with sparse attention.
Verify drafted responses with full attention and exact speculative sampling.
Keep drafting and verification on the same policy, plus KV-aware scheduling to reduce repeated cache offload/restore.
evidence_signal: On long-context mathematical reasoning, the method reached 1.39× and 1.35× end-to-end training throughput over autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3, with comparable task performance.
watch_item: Dense verification still needs the full historical KV cache, so KV-cache movement can remain a bottleneck if scheduling is not carefully managed.
paper_title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
